entities.summary: Neven Spahija is a Croatian professional basketball coach, who is currently the head coach for Reyer Venezia of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He spent four years in the NBA as an assistant coach with the Atlanta Hawks and Memphis Grizzlies.
